name: Amagi Michiru
source:
Touya's younger sister. She is another descendant of the Amagi family, but due to her past experiences, she is prohibited from going out to fight.

Unlike Touya, she has quite strong spiritual powers. She supports Touya by telling him where to find youkai. She speaks Kansai dialect for some reason.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou-3]official website[/url]]
